address: 162 Garnet Road, Westmere, Auckland, 1022, New Zealand
bio: A firm favourite among locals, this tiny gem is bustling. Its signature item is handmade duck fat flour tortillas, which the chef proudly proclaims are "100% not authentic"! Instead of expecting a Mexican meal, brace yourself for a mix of European, Asian and Middle Eastern flavours. Although the menu changes often, the duck carnitas tacos are usually on. The crispy, pan-seared pulled duck is a perfect match for the rich, aromatic duck fat tortillas.
